page.notes: The Arabic and Hebrew readings in the text, and the Greek word βελομαντεία, are uncertain and marked [?]. The Arabic note at the right is partly illegible and is transcribed approximately. The word "aveat" is doubtful. The last word of the page continues in the catchword "vare,". The asterisk note is in the right margin beside "Ebnol Athir".
